_meta.scope: Worker A candidates still needing location details, 39 records
_meta.method: Retried public original/source URLs, compared original index snippets, cross-referenced archived eight-source directory alignment and place-name/geographic sources; exact page failures distinguished from no-match. This is source-level cross-reference, not an on-the-ground survey or logged-in exhaustive eight-provider crawl.

summary.other_sources_caveat: Many sources are unindexed, inaccessible or require sign-in; absence of a matching public result is not proof the location is absent.
